The tallest is Edy Tavares at 220 cm. The youngest is Nick Smith Jr. (born 2004) and the most experienced Sergio Llull (born 1987). Beyond Spain, the squad draws most on France (3), USA (3) and Argentina (2). Facundo Campazzo, Gabriel Deck and Usman Garuba are back for another spell at the club.
